newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London boosted by Sony results.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London boosted by Sony results.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London recovered some of their overnight losses on Wednesday after Sony Corp gave export stocks a boost with handsome profits and a forecast of record profits this business year, traders said.
Sony shares were up 230 yen at 8,450 yen.
"The feeling is that whatever Sony can do, perhaps the other exporters can do too," one trader said. "Almost across the board, if they have a high export ratio, they're higher today."
Sharp was up 32.5 yen at 1,622.5 by 1630 GMT, Fujitsu was 30 yen higher at 1,230 yen, and Honda Motor was up 39 yen at 3,169 yen.

Sony on Wednesday reported group net profit of 75.38 billion yen ($612 million) for the last quarter, up 103 percent from the year before. It said profits would climb to a record high this business year, powered by strong sales and a weaker yen.
Banks also recovered their poise after Nippon Credit Bank Ltd denied rumours about its financial health and the Ministry of Finance said it would support the bank.
Sakura Bank, 18 yen higher at 695 yen by 1630 GMT, and Fuji Bank up 15 yen at 1275 yen, were the main banks to shine.

The 225-share Nikkei average closed 128.36 points or 0.7 percent lower in Tokyo at 18,185.97. In London the Nikkei 50 was down just 4.56 points or 0.3 percent at 1,369.05 from yesterday's London close.
